title: Basic Grip Engagement
texts: Easy fingerboard routine designed to learn quick-fire engagement

This introductory fingerboard routine is designed to teach climbers how to quickly engage holds using different gripping techniques.  

Find a hangboard, such as a Beastmaker 1000, with a mix of hold types.  With your feet on the ground, select a large flat edge, quickly grab the hold using a half crimp position, and engage the hold for 3 seconds.  Rest for 3 seconds and repeat using this grip 4 more times.  Once you’ve completed all 5 reps, rest for 2 minutes before repeating the same protocol using a sloper and open-handed grip.

You will complete 1 set x 5 reps using 3 different hold types for a total of 15 reps.
